context: Implemented #41: twining_why is now bounded — specificity/status/recency ranking, full-detail tier under max_tokens (default 4000), compact tier capped at 50 with omitted_count, superseded excluded by default, ids drill-down. TDD throughout; 1185 tests green.
rationale: both file and sqlite backends return full Decision objects with identical match semantics, so one engine-level implementation covers both; per-backend SQL ranking was rejected as duplication with drift risk.
summary: Chose to implement ranking/tiering entirely in DecisionEngine.why() rather than in the storage backends' getByScope
